title: Vibrant Japanese Ume Plum Paella
description: A floral and crisp Japanese-inspired paella dish featuring ume-plum, lardons-render, and high-protein friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a traditional paella pan. This kid-friendly dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.notes: boneless, skinless, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the sesame oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the diced lardons and cook until crispy, then set aside.
Add the chicken breast to the paella pan and cook until browned, then set aside with the lardons.
Add the cooked rice to the paella pan, stirring to combine with the remaining oil and crispy bits.
Add the soy sauce, salt, and black pepper to the rice mixture, stirring to combine.
Add the pitted ume plums, cooked chicken, and crispy lardons back into the paella pan, stirring to combine.
Transfer the paella pan to the preheated oven and cook for 20 minutes, or until the rice is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the paella pan from the oven and sprinkle with chopped green onions.
Serve the Vibrant Japanese Ume Plum Paella hot, straight from the paella pan.
